title: Filename filter UX is confusing as it's not clear setting mimetypes is also required
line: The desktop's "Hide matching"/"Show matching" file name filter now works out of the box, and the Filter page says when no file type is checked.
explanation: A file only matches the Folder View filter when its name fits the pattern and its type is in the checked list. The default list is the "all/all" wildcard, but the Filter page showed it as every type unchecked, and applying the page then saved an empty list, so a pattern like *.png matched nothing and the filter silently did nothing (or hid everything with "Show matching"). The page now shows every type checked for the wildcard, so a pattern alone works, and an inline message explains that the pattern only applies to checked types whenever none is checked.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: make the Filter page's file type rule visible

The default "all/all" file types showed as all unchecked, and applying
then saved an empty list, so the name pattern never matched anything.
Check every type for it, and say when no type is checked at all.

BUG: 502692

 containments/desktop/plugins/folder/mimetypesmodel.cpp    | 3 ++-

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ConfigFilter.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ConfigFilter.qml

media.caption: Master: Hide matching, *.png, default file types (shown unchecked), applied: a.png is still on the desktop.
Fixed: the default file types show as checked; Hide matching *.png hides a.png, b.txt stays.
Master: a pattern with no file type checked, and nothing on the page says types are needed.
Fixed: with no file type checked, the page explains that the pattern only applies to checked types.
